# Vendored browser dependency

`tailwind-play-20260802.js` is a local snapshot of the Tailwind Play CDN script
downloaded from `https://cdn.tailwindcss.com` on 2026-08-02.

Keeping the snapshot local prevents an unversioned CDN update from changing the
Family Menu pages unexpectedly. Review and replace this file deliberately when
upgrading Tailwind.
